basics.label: Professor of Herbology
basics.name: Neville Longbottom
basics.summary: Highly accomplished Herbology scholar and internationally recognised experimental botanist with extensive experience in field research, species documentation, and operating in challenging, occasionally hazardous environments. Proven leader and decorated veteran, adept at independent work, problem-solving under pressure, and maintaining conviction in the face of scepticism. Expertise in magically-responsive plant cultivars, conservation of endangered wizarding flora, and the discovery and documentation of previously uncatalogued magical species. Former Auror with tactical field experience.

education.institution: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry

projects.description: Catalogued 63 species of endangered magical flora across the Hogwarts grounds and surrounding region. Established a living seed bank of over 200 species in the Hogwarts greenhouse complex, including difficult-to-cultivate species. Developed propagation protocols for four species previously considered uncultivable in captivity. Trained twelve botanical researchers from partner institutions in magical plant handling and cultivation, demonstrating mentorship capabilities.

highlights: Supplied specially cultivated Mandrake rootstock for 'de-Petrification' therapy protocols, improving the potency and reliability of the restorative draught used for Petrification casualties
Consulted on the treatment of Venomous Tentacula exposure in four emergency cases, providing time-sensitive identification and recommended antidote plant components
volunteer.organization: St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries

highlights: Expanded the Hogwarts greenhouse complex, adding specialist facilities for venomous, carnivorous, and magically-active plant species, enhancing controlled research environments
Supervised 34 N.E.W.T.-level independent research projects over tenure, with twelve students pursuing careers in Herbological research or Magical Plant protection, demonstrating mentorship
Launched the Hogwarts Rare Wizarding Flora Preservation Programme, a collaboration with leading botanical institutions, focused on cataloguing and preserving endangered magical plant species
Led annual Forbidden Forest botanical surveys, resulting in the discovery and formal documentation of two previously uncatalogued magical plant species in the castle grounds
Introduced the 'Herbology in Healing' elective module for Fifth Years, linking plant-based potion ingredients to practical medical and apothecary applications, relevant for field sample collection
work.name: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry

highlights: Participated in the capture of six Death Eaters during active field operations in 1998–1999, demonstrating tactical effectiveness and composure in hazardous environments
Commended by Head Auror Harry Potter for exceptional composure and tactical effectiveness during complex field operations
Completed the full Auror training programme in twelve months despite no formal post-Hogwarts qualification, accepted on battlefield record, indicating strong practical aptitude for field work
Contributed firsthand field notes on Death Eater tactics and safe houses that informed twelve successful warrant operations, showcasing strong observational and reporting skills
work.name: Ministry of Magic

highlights: Reformed Dumbledore's Army in September 1997 under Death Eater occupation, demonstrating extreme leadership, personal risk assessment, and resilience in a hostile environment

Established and maintained a residential refuge for students in the Room of Requirement, sustainably housing up to twenty students with supplies and communication infrastructure under covert conditions
Coordinated supply lines and intelligence gathering with external contacts (Aberforth Dumbledore) to support resistance operations throughout the academic year
Commanded a section of Hogwarts's defensive perimeter during the Battle, directing student fighters and coordinating with staff and Order members, showcasing crisis leadership and resourcefulness
Destroyed Nagini (Voldemort's final Horcrux) with the Sword of Gryffindor, eliminating a primary threat under extreme duress and proving unwavering conviction in the face of overwhelming odds
